evals.name: ai-hiring-team-contract
evals.prompt: Our cross-functional team (3 designers, 2 PMs, 4 engineers, 1 data scientist) is building an AI-powered hiring tool. Before we write code, help us draft an ethical contract — role-specific commitments, shared principles, and accountability mechanisms.
evals.expected_output: Ethical contract with role-specific commitments for each discipline, shared principles, concrete accountability mechanisms, and escalation procedures.

evals.name: health-data-startup
evals.prompt: We're a health data startup (12 people) that just got access to anonymized hospital records for building predictive models. Draft an ethical contract for our team covering data handling, model bias, patient dignity, and what we refuse to build even if investors ask.
evals.expected_output: Contract with specific data handling commitments, bias testing requirements, patient-centered principles, and explicit red lines with enforcement mechanisms.

evals.name: content-moderation-team
evals.prompt: Our content moderation team reviews reported posts on a social platform. They're burning out from exposure to harmful content. Draft an ethical contract that covers the organization's duty to moderators, not just moderators' duty to users.
evals.expected_output: Bidirectional ethical contract covering organizational duty of care to moderators, exposure limits, mental health support commitments, and worker agency provisions.
